11/// Font data and metadata for downstream use.
12#[derive(Clone)]
13pub struct OutlineFontData {
14    /// Raw font bytes (TrueType/OpenType/CFF data).
15    pub data: crate::third_party::hayro_interpret::font::FontData,
16    /// Cache key for font deduplication.
17    pub cache_key: u128,
18    /// PostScript name (e.g., "TimesNewRomanPS-BoldMT").
19    pub postscript_name: Option<String>,
20    /// Font weight (100-900, 400=normal, 700=bold).
21    pub weight: Option<u32>,
22    /// Whether the font is italic/oblique.
23    pub is_italic: bool,
24    /// Whether the font is serif (vs sans-serif).
25    pub is_serif: bool,
26    /// Whether the font is monospace.
27    pub is_monospace: bool,
28}

30pub(crate) struct OutlinePath(BezPath);
31
32impl OutlinePath {
33    pub(crate) fn new() -> Self {
34        Self(BezPath::new())
35    }
36
37    pub(crate) fn take(self) -> BezPath {
38        self.0
39    }
40}
41
42impl OutlinePen for OutlinePath {
43    #[inline]
44    fn move_to(&mut self, x: f32, y: f32) {
45        self.0.move_to((x, y));
46    }
47
48    #[inline]
49    fn line_to(&mut self, x: f32, y: f32) {
50        if !self.0.elements().is_empty() {
51            self.0.line_to((x, y));
52        }
53    }
54
55    #[inline]
56    fn quad_to(&mut self, cx: f32, cy: f32, x: f32, y: f32) {
57        if !self.0.elements().is_empty() {
58            self.0.quad_to((cx, cy), (x, y));
59        }
60    }
61
62    #[inline]
63    fn curve_to(&mut self, cx0: f32, cy0: f32, cx1: f32, cy1: f32, x: f32, y: f32) {
64        if !self.0.elements().is_empty() {
65            self.0.curve_to((cx0, cy0), (cx1, cy1), (x, y));
66        }
67    }
68
69    #[inline]
70    fn close(&mut self) {
71        if !self.0.elements().is_empty() {
72            self.0.close_path();
73        }
74    }
75}

77#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
78pub(crate) enum OutlineFont {
79    Type1(Rc<Type1Font>),
80    TrueType(Rc<TrueTypeFont>),
81    Type0(Rc<Type0Font>),
82}
83
84impl CacheKey for OutlineFont {
85    fn cache_key(&self) -> u128 {
86        match self {
87            Self::Type1(f) => f.cache_key(),
88            Self::TrueType(t) => t.cache_key(),
89            Self::Type0(t0) => t0.cache_key(),
90        }
91    }
92}
93
94impl OutlineFont {
95    pub(crate) fn outline_glyph(&self, glyph: GlyphId, code: u32) -> BezPath {
96        match self {
97            Self::Type1(t) => t.outline_glyph(glyph),
98            Self::TrueType(t) => t.outline_glyph(glyph),
99            Self::Type0(t) => t.outline_glyph(glyph, code),
100        }
101    }
102
103    pub(crate) fn char_code_to_unicode(&self, char_code: u32) -> Option<BfString> {
104        match self {
105            Self::Type1(t) => t.char_code_to_unicode(char_code),
106            Self::TrueType(t) => t.char_code_to_unicode(char_code),
107            Self::Type0(t) => t.char_code_to_unicode(char_code),
108        }
109    }
110
111    /// Get the advance width for a glyph by character code.
112    pub(crate) fn glyph_advance_width(&self, char_code: u32) -> Option<f32> {
113        match self {
114            Self::Type1(t) => t.glyph_width(char_code as u8),
115            Self::TrueType(t) => Some(t.glyph_width(char_code as u8)),
116            Self::Type0(t) => Some(t.code_advance(char_code).x as f32),
117        }
118    }
119
120    /// Get raw font bytes and metadata.
121    ///
122    /// Returns None for Type1 fonts and non-embedded TrueType fonts.
123    pub(crate) fn font_data(&self) -> Option<OutlineFontData> {
124        match self {
125            Self::Type1(_) => None,
126            Self::TrueType(t) => Some(OutlineFontData {
127                data: t.font_data()?,
128                cache_key: t.cache_key(),
129                postscript_name: t.postscript_name().map(|s| s.to_string()),
130                weight: t.weight(),
131                is_italic: t.is_italic(),
132                is_serif: t.is_serif(),
133                is_monospace: t.is_monospace(),
134            }),
135            Self::Type0(t) => Some(OutlineFontData {
136                data: t.font_data()?,
137                cache_key: t.cache_key(),
138                postscript_name: t.postscript_name().map(|s| s.to_string()),
139                weight: t.weight(),
140                is_italic: t.is_italic(),
141                is_serif: t.is_serif(),
142                is_monospace: t.is_monospace(),
143            }),
144        }
145    }
146}
